name: Lepidosauria
blurb: The tuatara of New Zealand is the last survivor of a lineage that separated from lizards and snakes long ago.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (PhyloBayes, CAT-GTR), calibration scheme C16; mean and conservative 95% credibility interval (extremes of the 95% CIs of 100 gene-jackknife timetrees)
clock.checked: Irisarri et al. 2017, Supplementary Table 9, node 125 ("Lepidosaurians (Lepidosauria)")
